verdict.rationale: iTerm2 ships its own generative AI capability: an optional AI plugin (iterm2-docs-15, iterm2-docs-50) and a built-in LLM chat window that can run commands on your behalf (iterm2-gh-6). A hands-on user report confirms that a natural-language prompt produced a correct awk command much faster than searching (iterm2-comm-5-refresh-e25923d9a38a8681). However, the evidence shows generation through a separate chat/Codecierge toolbox (iterm2-comm-9) rather than in place at the shell prompt, and it needs a separately installed plugin plus the user's own API key (iterm2-comm-3-refresh-a2aeeb9bc7c4ec3a), so the reviewer's concern holds and this stays partial. Missing for 10: evidence of in-place command generation at the shell prompt, in-depth first-party docs on the natural-language-to-command workflow, and delivery without a separate plugin and user-supplied API key.
